observations: sacg_memory_truth in the supplied state summary is authoritative and reports three active contamination barriers, one open Stage7 retry request, and zero open backtrack requests. The rejected artifact.stage7.verification_result, artifact.stage7.real_tool_results, and artifact.stage7.debug_closure remain planning/debug evidence only.

The active Stage7 failure is a verification-contract and DUT loader/harness binding failure. The semantic testbench and leaf scaffolds did not establish a real RTL value, liveness, data-order, transfer, or protocol mismatch; dependent leaf functional, golden-comparison, and semantic-aggregation tools were not_run.

Visible checker evidence identifies specific current blockers: the DUT binding status is not pass, accelerator_scope is not transformer_blocks_only, checkpoint and reference hashes do not match verification preparation, all 12 required current-scope tensor hashes and consumption proof are absent, default/identity fallback remains possible, required stage harness bindings are absent, and semantic testbench loading lacks target_model_inference, dut_weight_binding, and numeric_policy_sha256 bindings.

The effective comparison contract lacks explicit atol, rtol, and max_mismatch_fraction. Although a numeric-policy artifact exists, the checker-proven binding gap is current. Those values cannot be filled in or loosened during Stage8; human approval and a Stage6 contract backtrack are required.

The supplied failure narrative says complete-checkpoint catalog and independent target-model reference checks passed, but that statement is carried by rejected Stage7 evidence. It may guide recovery, but the retry must rebind and hash-check the independent reference against the promoted Stage6 immutable identity before it can support a pass.

Correcting scope or hash declarations alone is insufficient. The bounded repair must bind the actual immutable checkpoint/reference, remove fallback behavior, hash every required Transformer-block tensor, bind the loader and harness, and generate executed proof that the DUT consumed every required tensor.

The accelerator acceptance boundary remains Transformer blocks only. Embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work are excluded from DUT implementation, weight coverage, and golden comparison.

Shape, stream order, transfer counts, memory addressing, runtime ABI, and board protocol correctness remain unresolved rather than failed because functional execution was dependency-blocked. They must not be reported as passed or used to justify a hardware code repair.

The compact candidate artifact intentionally omits detailed rows. No additional missing-field blocker is inferred from that compact representation; decisions are based on the visible checker failures and authoritative SACG blocker set.

Earlier historical operator-leaf or single-layer outcomes do not override the active failed transition. A numeric-contract revision can also invalidate certificate reuse unless immutable-identity and artifact-hash checks explicitly prove reuse eligibility.

The active Stage7 retry and barriers do not prevent producing this Stage8 disposition or a Stage6 backtrack request. They do block downstream consumption, promotion, single-layer execution, and board execution until a superseding retry passes.

APPROVAL-REQUIRED: Ask the human to approve explicit atol, rtol, and max_mismatch_fraction without changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, or acceptance scope.
BACKTRACK-REQUIRED: After approval, submit a Stage6 backtrack request for a superseding immutable verification and semantic-binding contract.

AUTO-ALLOWED: Once the refined Stage6 contract is promoted, repair the trusted-template DUT loader/harness binding, complete all required Transformer-block tensor hashes, remove fallback behavior, and add executable consumption instrumentation.
RETRY-ONLY: Gate and execute retry_request.0001 at operator-leaf scope using the exact refined contract and artifact hashes.
AUTO-ALLOWED CONDITIONAL: If new real simulator evidence demonstrates an RTL failure, localize the earliest causal boundary before authorizing any bounded code repair.
RETRY-ONLY: Promote the superseding Stage7 artifacts and retire the active retry/barriers only after all required current-scope real-tool and semantic-evidence checkers pass.
FORBIDDEN: Do not mutate golden outputs or immutable identities, bypass checkers, expand DUT scope beyond Transformer blocks, skip verification layers, or substitute a simplified board wrapper.

repair_decision.non_overlap_rule: Each listed action has one disposition. Approval establishes human-owned numeric policy; backtrack supersedes the incomplete Stage6 contract; bounded repair changes only loader/harness and trusted template bindings; retry executes only the failed operator-leaf scope; forbidden actions cannot be converted into repairs or retries.
repair_decision.route: human numeric-policy approval -> Stage6 contract backtrack -> bounded loader/harness binding repair -> operator-leaf-only Stage7 retry -> checker-gated promotion

risks: Editing only the weight manifest labels could conceal rather than repair checkpoint, scope, tensor-coverage, or consumption defects.
Reusing a sampled tensor subset or treating file existence as complete weight evidence would permit unverified weights to reach the DUT.
Inventing tolerance values, loosening tolerance after failure, changing the expected output, or regenerating a reference from changed inputs would contaminate the verification contract.

Generating expected outputs randomly, from RTL output, or through identity/default behavior would invalidate functional correctness evidence. Random generation is permitted only for deterministic input stimulus.
A loader/harness repair that alters architecture, pipeline structure, memory layout, runtime ABI, or a major trusted template exceeds automatic repair authority and requires approval.
Running single-layer, multilayer, AXI/DDR, synthesis, implementation, or board runtime before current operator-leaf promotion would violate the required three-layer repair loop.
At board level, use of any wrapper other than the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and source hashes would invalidate board evidence; board work is not eligible in the current repair scope.
Stale historical certificates or contaminated Stage7 outputs could be accidentally consumed as validated inputs unless the retry envelope and barrier checks enforce revision identity.
Because leaf functional tools were not_run, proposing an arithmetic RTL change now would be symptom-driven and causally unsupported.
